scheme_name: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana - Coaching To Scheduled Tribe Student Studying In Class Xth, XIth & XIIth
description:
The Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India to provide coaching and support to Scheduled Tribe students who are studying in Class X, XI, and XII. 

This scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2020. 

It aims to enhance the educational opportunities for Scheduled Tribe students by providing them with quality coaching for competitive examinations. 

The primary objective of the Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana is to improve the academic performance of Scheduled Tribe students. 

The scheme specifically targets students who are preparing for entrance examinations for higher education institutions. 

These entrance examinations include those for engineering, medical, and other professional courses. 

The government has set a measurable target of coaching at least 50,000 Scheduled Tribe students under this scheme annually. 

The coaching provided under this scheme is intended to help students achieve a minimum of 75% marks in their respective board examinations. 

Additionally, the program aims to increase the representation of Scheduled Tribe students in prestigious institutions. 

The benefits of the Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana include free coaching classes for students. 

Students enrolled in the scheme receive study materials, practice tests, and guidance from experienced faculty members. 

The government allocates a budget of ₹100 crore annually for the effective implementation of this scheme. 

Each student enrolled in the coaching program is provided with a stipend of ₹2,000 per month to cover their living expenses. 

The scheme also covers the costs of transportation for students traveling to coaching centers. 

Eligibility criteria for the Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana are specifically defined. 

Students must belong to Scheduled Tribe communities as recognized by the Government of India. 

They must be currently enrolled in Class X, XI, or XII in recognized schools. 

The income limit for families to qualify for this scheme is set at ₹2.5 lakh per annum. 

Students must have a minimum attendance of 75% in their regular classes to be eligible for coaching. 

The application process for the Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana involves several steps. 

Interested students must fill out the online application form available on the official website of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs. 

They must provide necessary documents such as caste certificates, income certificates, and proof of enrollment in school. 

Students are also required to submit their academic records from previous classes. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the respective authorities. 

Selected candidates are notified through the official website and via email. 

The coaching classes are conducted in various centers across the country. 

These centers are established in collaboration with reputed coaching institutions. 

The timeline for the coaching program typically begins in April each year. 

Classes are conducted for a duration of six months, leading up to the board examinations. 

The frequency of classes is usually five days a week, with additional weekend sessions for revision. 

The implementing authority for the Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana is the Ministry of Tribal Affairs. 

The Ministry has established a dedicated team to oversee the implementation and monitoring of the scheme. 

Contact details for the Ministry of Tribal Affairs can be found on their official website. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to uplift the educational status of Scheduled Tribes in India. 

The Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana is aligned with the National Education Policy 2020. 

This policy emphasizes equitable access to quality education for all marginalized communities. 

The scheme also aims to bridge the gap in educational attainment between Scheduled Tribe students and their peers. 

Statistically, Scheduled Tribe students have historically faced challenges in accessing quality coaching and educational resources. 

The Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana seeks to address these disparities. 

By providing targeted support, the government aims to empower Scheduled Tribe students to pursue higher education. 

The scheme also encourages students to develop skills that are essential for competitive examinations. 

This includes critical thinking, problem-solving, and effective communication. 

The coaching centers are equipped with modern facilities and resources to aid learning. 

Students receive personalized attention to address their specific academic needs. 

The government regularly evaluates the performance of the coaching centers to ensure quality standards. 

Feedback from students is also collected to improve the program continuously. 

The Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana is a crucial step towards achieving educational equity in India. 

It reflects the government's commitment to the empowerment of marginalized communities. 

The scheme not only focuses on academic excellence but also on holistic development. 

Students are encouraged to participate in extracurricular activities to enhance their overall personality. 

The initiative has received positive feedback from various stakeholders, including educators and community leaders. 

It is seen as a model for similar initiatives aimed at other marginalized groups in the country. 

The long-term vision of the Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana is to create a generation of well-educated and skilled individuals from Scheduled Tribes. 

This will contribute to the socio-economic development of these communities. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on the educational landscape of India. 

Overall, the Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana represents a significant investment in the future of Scheduled Tribe students. 

It aims to provide them with the tools and resources necessary to succeed in their academic and professional pursuits. 

Through this initiative, the government hopes to create a more inclusive and equitable society. 

The Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana is a testament to the importance of education as a fundamental right. 

It underscores the belief that every child, regardless of their background, deserves access to quality education. 

The scheme is a vital component of India's broader strategy to achieve sustainable development goals related to education. 

In conclusion, the Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana is a comprehensive program designed to uplift Scheduled Tribe students. 

It provides them with the necessary support to excel academically and pursue their dreams.
